name: Blue RN Caduceus Badge Reel and Badge Buddy Set
seoTitle: RN Badge Reel and Badge Buddy Set for Nurses
metaDescription: A blue caduceus RN badge reel paired with a matching badge buddy. A tidy, coordinated gift for registered nurses and new grads starting their first job.
summary: A matching RN badge reel and badge buddy with a blue caduceus and stethoscope design, an easy coordinated gift for a registered nurse.
whyItWorks: Passing boards and earning those two letters is a big deal, and RN gear lets a nurse show it every day. A set takes the guesswork out of matching: the reel holds the ID and retracts for door scanners and med cabinet taps, while the badge buddy spells out the role so patients know who their nurse is. The blue caduceus and stethoscope artwork, with a touch of glitter, looks professional with almost any scrub color.

Gift buyers like sets because they feel more complete than a single item, yet they still tuck easily into a card or a graduation bag. It is a smart pick for a new grad heading into orientation, since a first badge often arrives plain. It also works as a thank you for a preceptor or charge nurse. We like it paired with a good pen or a small coffee treat for the first week on the floor.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos to see how the badge buddy attaches and which badge orientation it suits.
The RN text makes it best for registered nurses rather than LPNs or CNAs.
It makes a good add on to a pinning ceremony or graduation gift.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing graduate?
faq.a: Yes, it is a practical way to celebrate the new RN title, and most new grads will use it on their first job. Pair it with a card or a lapel pin for a fuller gift.

faq.q: Can she use it with her current hospital badge?
faq.a: The alligator clip works with most standard ID badges. Check the listing for the badge buddy size so it lines up with her ID.
